name: ShowOps Agent
author: ShowOps
description: Connects this FPP player to your ShowOps account at api.showops.io. Status is reported there, and a private connection can open this player's FPP pages when you ask. The agent is closed source and does not replace its own binary. Pair only on a trusted network. Raspberry Pi and BeagleBone only.

privacy.summary: ShowOps watches this player and alerts you if the show does not start. The live song is sent only while its page is open. A private connection to its FPP pages opens only when you ask.

sends.what: name, versions, playback, show time, CPU, memory and disk use
sends.why: to show this player's status in your ShowOps account

sends.what: MAC address hash, location, diagnostics, backups, and the song while its page is open
sends.why: to pair, map, troubleshoot, or restore this player when you turn that on

sends.what: this player's FPP pages during a remote session
sends.why: so someone signed in to ShowOps can open them

systemChanges.what: Installs the ShowOps agent as a service, run as the fpp user
Install fetches the closed-source agent from api.showops.io and pinned cloudflared from github.com
Remote support opens a private connection to this player's FPP pages
On request sets restart and reboot banners, upgrades FPP or the OS, edits playlists, and restores a backup
Backup reads FPP settings and removes password, token, key, and secret fields before upload
Probes LAN hosts only when you list them, and the list is empty until you do
Restarts the ShowOps service with FPP's sudo helper and stops fppd through FPP's API

privacy.other: Pair only on a trusted network. The agent does not replace its own binary; Plugin Manager installs updates. Remote support is signed in through ShowOps, idle-limited, and reaches another LAN host only if you listed it. cloudflared stays on the pinned 2024.8.3 build. Pairing credentials stay in plugindata until Unpair.
